result.summary: This residential intersection features sidewalks but lacks essential crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and vehicles parked near the corners create potential visibility and accessibility challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb without a sloped transition, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian infrastructure or traffic control devices. While the low-speed residential context is inherently safer than a major arterial, the absence of crosswalks and stop signs creates ambiguity at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection fails to provide a clear visual cue for drivers to expect pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the street corner

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate vehicle right-of-way at the junction, increasing the risk of conflicts.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to manage vehicle speeds and provide predictable gaps for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Upgrade existing ramps with detectable warning surfaces (truncated domes) to assist visually impaired pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential one-way street with multi-story brick apartment buildings. While a sidewalk is present on the right side separated by a wide grass buffer, the environment lacks marked crossings and features significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points for residents moving between apartment buildings on opposite sides of the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line block the visibility of pedestrians, particularly children, who may step into the street from between vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway where cars are parked
